season.evidence: Mountaineers and trail pages: crampons in early season, mountain-forecast lists Jul-Sep as the best months, Peakbagger ascents spread across all months with a winter snowshoe tradition; stored Jun-Oct kept, May tolerated.

facts.text: In late September and early October, the small tarns near the top are a usable overnight spot, but the first tarn has room for only about one small tent.

notes: Our trailhead pin matches the coordinate on the public hike page (47.7931, -121.6449), so no move. Recent in-season recordings almost all begin at the locked highway gate about 3.8 km away or run on to Mount Index, so none is a trailhead round trip of this route.
